exercise.name: Cable Hip Adduction
library_steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the cuff on your near ankle.
Hold the machine and let the cable pull that leg out slightly.
Sweep the leg inwards and across your body, past your standing foot.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your set.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing on one leg side-on to a low pulley, a cuff on the near ankle and the near hand on the machine; the straight near leg sweeps from ~22 deg out to the side, inward and across in front of the standing foot. The hip adductors on the inner thigh do the work.

setup.target: Low pulley (~0.1 m), ankle cuff on the near ankle.
Near hand holds the machine; trunk upright; standing leg straight.

movement.end: -15 (across in front of the standing foot)

muscles.emg: Adductor longus 14-108 % nEMG across hip adduction exercises (S1); adductor forces modelled per exercise (S2).
muscles.role: Pull the leg in and across; what the exercise is for.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Trunk tips to swing the leg.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Moves the work off the adductors.

sources.citation: Serner A, Jakobsen MD, Andersen LL, et al. 2014. EMG evaluation of hip adduction exercises for soccer players: implications for exercise selection in prevention and treatment of groin injuries. Br J Sports Med 48(14):1108-1114.
sources.what_it_gave: Eight hip adduction exercises incl. standing adduction against resistance: adductor longus 14-108 % nEMG; gluteals and abdominals low.

sources.citation: Collings TJ, Horsman A, Hams AH, et al. 2026. Hip adductor muscle forces during strength training and rehabilitation exercises. Med Sci Sports Exerc 58:1751-1763.
sources.what_it_gave: EMG-driven model of the adductor brevis, longus, magnus and gracilis in eight exercises incl. a lying leg lift (hip adduction against gravity).

clip_check.check: Start: leg out to the side under cable tension
End: leg across in front of the standing foot, not through it
Cuff on the near ankle; near fist on the grip; far fist on the hip
Inner thigh of the working leg strongest red
